description:

Internal Vent and Pressure Valves

Quantity: 2

NSN: 4810-01-054-9843

-------------------------------------------------------------------

2. Does your firm have an approved Source of Approved Request (SAR) by the F-16 System Program Office (SPO)?

3. Is your firm projected to be AFREP SAR approved in the next 30 calendar days?
